operations.before:
import_statement: $ => seq(
      '@import',
      $._value,
      sep(',', $._query),
      ';',
    ),

    media_statement: $ => seq(
      '@media',
      sep1(',', $._query),
      $.block,
    ),
operations.after:
import_statement: $ => seq(
      kw('@import'),
      $._value,
      optional(choice(
        alias('layer', $.keyword_query),
        alias($._import_layer, $.call_expression),
      )),
      optional(alias($._import_supports, $.call_expression)),
      sep(',', $._query),
      ';',
    ),

    _import_layer: $ => seq(alias('layer', $.function_name), $.arguments),

    _import_supports: $ => seq(alias('supports', $.function_name), alias($._supports_arguments, $.arguments)),

    _supports_arguments: $ => seq(
      token.immediate('('),
      choice(
        alias($._supports_declaration, $.feature_query),
        $._query,
      ),
      ')',
    ),

    _supports_declaration: $ => seq(alias($.identifier, $.feature_name), ':', repeat1($._value)),

    media_statement: $ => seq(
      kw('@media'),
      sep(',', $._query),
      $.block,
    ),

at_rule: $ => seq(
      $.at_keyword,
      repeat($._prelude_item),
      choice(';', $.block),
    ),

    // css-syntax-3 at-rule prelude: any component values; queries keep their structure
    _prelude_item: $ => choice(
      $._query,
      ',',
      $.integer_value,
      $.float_value,
      $.string_value,
      $.grid_value,
      '!', '~=', '|=', '^=', '$=', '*=', ':', '=', '*', '+', '>', '<', '~', '/', '.', '&', '|', '#',
    ),

    _last_at_rule: $ => seq(
      $.at_keyword,
      repeat($._prelude_item),
    ),

    _layer_statement: $ => seq(
      alias(/@[lL][aA][yY][eE][rR]/, $.at_keyword),
      optional($._layer_names),
      choice(';', $.block),
    ),

    // a hidden non-terminal around the names (like _query), so an incremental parse that rebuilds
    // the at-rule still reuses the name nodes
    _layer_names: $ => sep1(',', alias($._layer_name, $.keyword_query)),

    // <layer-name> = <ident> ['.' <ident>]* without whitespace
    _layer_name: $ => seq($._layer_ident, repeat(seq(token.immediate('.'), $._layer_ident_part))),

    _layer_ident: _ => /-?[a-zA-Z_\xA0-\xFF][a-zA-Z0-9-_\xA0-\xFF]*/,

    _layer_ident_part: _ => token.immediate(/-?[a-zA-Z_\xA0-\xFF][a-zA-Z0-9-_\xA0-\xFF]*/),

block: $ => seq(
      '{',
      repeat(choice($._block_item, ';')),
      optional(choice(
        alias($.last_declaration, $.declaration),
        alias($._last_at_rule, $.at_rule),
      )),
      '}',
    ),

pseudo_class_nth_of_type_arguments: $ => prec(-1, seq(
      token.immediate('('),
      choice(
        alias('even', $.plain_value),
        alias('odd', $.plain_value),
        $.integer_value,
        alias($._nth_functional_notation, $.plain_value),
      ),
      ')',
    )),

    // An+B notation (css-syntax-3 6.2): the sign is glued to n, whitespace only around the B sign.
    _nth_functional_notation: _ => /[+-]?\d*n(\s*[+-]\s*\d+)?/,

operations.before:
declaration: $ => seq(
      alias($.identifier, $.property_name),
      ':',
      $._value,
      repeat(seq(
        optional(','),
        $._value,
      )),
      optional($.important),
      ';',
    ),

    last_declaration: $ => prec(1, seq(
      alias($.identifier, $.property_name),
      ':',
      $._value,
      repeat(seq(
        optional(','),
        $._value,
      )),
      optional($.important),
    )),

    important: _ => '!important',
operations.after:
declaration: $ => seq(
      $._declaration_body,
      ';',
    ),

    last_declaration: $ => prec(1, $._declaration_body),

    _declaration_body: $ => choice(
      seq(
        alias(choice($.identifier, $._escaped_name), $.property_name),
        ':',
        $._value,
        repeat(seq(
          optional(','),
          $._value,
        )),
        optional($.important),
      ),
      // css-syntax-3: a custom property's value is any component values, {}-blocks included, possibly none
      seq(
        alias($._custom_property_name, $.property_name),
        alias($._custom_property_colon, ':'),
        repeat(choice($._value, $.block, ',')),
        optional($.important),
      ),
    ),

    _custom_property_name: $ => seq($._custom_ident, repeat($._name_tail)),

    // P2-21: '!' and 'important' are separate tokens (comments and whitespace may sit between), ASCII case-insensitive
    important: _ => seq('!', /[iI][mM][pP][oO][rR][tT][aA][nN][tT]/),

$.selector_query,
      $.parenthesized_query,
      $.range_query,
      $.call_expression,
      $.general_enclosed,
    ),

    // MQ4 <mf-range>
    range_query: $ => seq(
      '(',
      choice(
        seq(alias($.identifier, $.feature_name), choice('<', '<=', '>', '>=', '='), $._value),
        seq($._range_value, choice('<', '<=', '>', '>=', '='), alias($.identifier, $.feature_name)),
        seq($._range_value, choice('<', '<='), alias($.identifier, $.feature_name), choice('<', '<='), $._value),
        seq($._range_value, choice('>', '>='), alias($.identifier, $.feature_name), choice('>', '>='), $._value),
      ),
      ')',
    ),

    // <mf-value> before the name: <number>, <dimension> or <ratio>
    _range_value: $ => choice($.integer_value, $.float_value, alias($._ratio, $.binary_expression)),

    _ratio: $ => seq(choice($.integer_value, $.float_value), '/', choice($.integer_value, $.float_value)),

    // MQ4 / css-conditional <general-enclosed> '(' <any-value> ')'
    general_enclosed: $ => seq('(', $._enclosed_value, repeat1($._enclosed_value), ')'),

    _enclosed_value: $ => prec(-1, choice(
      alias($.identifier, $.plain_value),
      $.integer_value,
      $.float_value,
      $.string_value,
      $.call_expression,
    )),

    feature_query: $ => seq(

operations.before:
call_expression: $ => seq(
      alias($.identifier, $.function_name),
      $.arguments,
    ),

    binary_expression: $ => prec.left(seq(
      $._value,
      choice('+', '-', '*', '/'),
      $._value,
    )),

    arguments: $ => seq(
      token.immediate('('),
      sep(choice(',', ';'), repeat1($._value)),
      ')',
    ),
operations.after:
call_expression: $ => choice(
      seq(alias($.identifier, $.function_name), $.arguments),
      seq(alias($._math_function_name, $.function_name), alias($._math_arguments, $.arguments)),
      seq(alias($._url_function_name, $.function_name), alias($._url_arguments, $.arguments)),
    ),

    binary_expression: $ => choice(
      prec.left(1, seq($._value, choice('+', '-'), $._value)),
      prec.left(2, seq($._value, choice('*', '/'), $._value)),
    ),

    // P2-16: a segment after a separator may be empty (var(--m,))
    arguments: $ => seq(
      token.immediate('('),
      optional(seq(
        repeat1($._argument),
        repeat(seq(choice(',', ';'), repeat($._argument))),
      )),
      ')',
    ),

    // Outside math functions '/' is a separator, not division (css-values-4 <color> syntax, ratios)
    _argument: $ => prec(-1, choice(
      alias($.identifier, $.plain_value),
      $.plain_value,
      $.color_value,
      $.integer_value,
      $.float_value,
      $.string_value,
      $.grid_value,
      $.parenthesized_value,
      $.call_expression,
      $.important,
      '/',
    )),

    _math_arguments: $ => seq(
      token.immediate('('),
      sep(',', $._value),
      ')',
    ),

    // css-syntax-3 url-token, or url( <string> )
    _url_arguments: $ => seq(
      token.immediate('('),
      optional(choice(
        $.string_value,
        // whitespace inside is kept (a bad-url in css-syntax-3) so line-broken data: URLs stay one value
        alias(/([^\s"'()\\]|\\[^\n\r\f])(([^"'()\\]|\\[^\n\r\f])*([^\s"'()\\]|\\[^\n\r\f]))?/, $.plain_value),
      )),
      ')',
    ),

operations.before:
plain_value: _ => token(seq(
      repeat(choice(
        /[-_]/,
        /\/[^\*\s,;!{}()\[\]]/, // Slash not followed by a '*' (which would be a comment)
      )),
      /[a-zA-Z]/,
      repeat(choice(
        /[^/\s,;!{}()\[\]]/, // Not a slash, not a delimiter character
        /\/[^\*\s,;!{}()\[\]]/, // Slash not followed by a '*' (which would be a comment)
      )),
    )),
operations.after:
plain_value: _ => token(seq(
      repeat(/[-_]/),
      /[a-zA-Z]/,
      repeat(/[^/\s,;!{}()\[\]]/), // Not a slash, not a delimiter character
      optional(seq('//', repeat(/[^\s,;!{}()\[\]]/))), // scheme://rest, e.g. http://host/path
    )),
